# ai-ui-rewrite-rust

> A Rust port of assistant-ui: chat runtime, AI SDK streaming, incremental Markdown and an optional Slint chat UI, as ten crates on crates.io.

Coding agents: read the skill below first, then the guides. The runtime has no executor of its own and uses single-threaded Rc-based runtimes. Minimum Rust is 1.85 (ai-ui-markdown 1.88, Slint crates 1.92).

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/README.md): Overview, install and licences.
- [Why ai-ui](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/00-why-ai-ui.md): What the port is for and what it measured against assistant-ui.
- [Getting started](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/01-getting-started.md): Add the crates, run a first conversation.
- [Concepts](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/02-concepts.md): Runtimes, messages, branching, composers, tools and thread lists.
- [Streaming and backends](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/03-streaming-and-backends.md): Wire formats, decoders and HTTP backends.
- [Slint UI](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/04-ui-slint.md): The controlled Slint components and the thread example.
- [Web](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/05-web.md): Running in the browser via WebAssembly.
- [Crates](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/06-crates.md): The ten published crates and what each owns.
- [Performance](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/07-performance.md): Measured results, method and limits.
- [From assistant-ui](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/08-from-assistant-ui.md): Mapping the React concepts to the Rust crates.
- [Contributing](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/09-contributing.md): Build, test and the verification gate.
- [FAQ](https://github.com/iyiolacak/ai-ui-rewrite-rust/blob/main/docs/guide/10-faq.md): Common questions and known issues.
